model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.start: the point of intersection of the centrelines of Highway 99 and the British Columbia Railway right of way, within Lot 4096, Lillooet Land District
steps.quote: Commencing at the point of intersection of the centrelines of Highway 99 and the British Columbia Railway right of way, within Lot 4096, Lillooet Land District
thence due North to the 450 m elevation contour

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of Pemberton Creek
steps.quote: thence in a general northeasterly direction along said elevation contour to the point of intersection with the midline of Pemberton Creek

steps.until: the point of intersection with the 350 m elevation contour
steps.quote: thence in a general northeasterly direction along said midline to the point of intersection with the 350 m elevation contour

steps.until: the point due West of the intersection of the centreline of Pemberton Valley road and the midline of Ryan River
steps.quote: thence in a general northwesterly direction along said elevation contour to the point due West of the intersection of the centreline of Pemberton Valley road and the midline of Ryan River

steps.until: the natural boundary of Ryan River, on the northern bank thereof
steps.quote: thence northeasterly in a straight line to the natural boundary of Ryan River, on the northern bank thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Lillooet River, on the western bank thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general southeasterly direction along said natural boundary to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Lillooet River, on the western bank thereof

steps.until: the natural boundary of Lillooet River, on the eastern bank thereof
steps.quote: thence due East to the natural boundary of Lillooet River, on the eastern bank thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with the northern boundary of the right of way of British Columbia Railway
steps.quote: thence in a general southeasterly direction along said natural boundary to the point of intersection with the northern boundary of the right of way of British Columbia Railway

steps.direction: in a general easterly and northerly direction
steps.until: the point of intersection with the northern boundary of Mount Currie IR 10
steps.quote: thence in a general easterly and northerly direction along said right of way boundary to the point of intersection with the northern boundary of Mount Currie IR 10

steps.until: the point of intersection with the boundary of Mount IR 6
steps.quote: thence easterly along said northern boundary and along the prolongation thereof to the point of intersection with the boundary of Mount IR 6

steps.until: the point due North of the midline of Gravell Creek, at its confluence with Lillooet River
steps.quote: thence easterly along the boundary of Mount Currie IR 6 to the point due North of the midline of Gravell Creek, at its confluence with Lillooet River
thence due South to said midline
thence in a general southerly direction along said midline to the 350 m elevation contour

steps.until: the point of intersection with the boundary of Nairn Falls Provincial Park
steps.quote: thence in a general westerly direction along said elevation contour to the point of intersection with the boundary of Nairn Falls Provincial Park

steps.until: the southwest corner of said Park
steps.quote: thence southwesterly along said boundary to the southwest corner of said Park
thence northerly in a straight line to the point of commencement

quotes.quote: Commencing at the point of intersection of the centrelines of Highway 99
